zh.title: 八打灵再也电子锁安装｜门体兼容核对｜FLASH CAST
zh.description: 八打灵再也公寓与有地住宅电子锁安装。先核对门厚、锁体与门框宽度，再供应、安装、录入使用者并做交付测试。
zh.keywords: 八打灵再也电子锁安装, PJ 智能门锁, 门锁更换
zh.h1: 八打灵再也电子锁安装
zh.entityName: 八打灵再也电子锁安装
zh.body:
八打灵再也的门况是巴生谷里分化最明显的一类。SS 一带的排屋多数建于 1970 到 1990 年代，入户门是实木门或夹板门，配的是旧式 mortise 锁体，门边常被前几次换锁修整过；较新的 PJ 公寓则多用防火木门配标准锁孔，主流电子锁基本能直接替换。这两种门在同一区内同时存在，所以只看照片给型号很容易失准。

这一区最常遇到的三种门

第一种是老排屋的木门，门厚标称 40 毫米，但实际可用厚度会被饰面和修边吃掉几毫米，锁体又常是浅孔做法，装全自动推拉锁时锁舌行程不够，需要重新修孔。第二种是排屋加装的铁花门，铁花与木门之间的净距往往只有 60 到 90 毫米，决定键盘能不能装在有把手的那一侧。第三种是 2000 年后公寓的防火门，门芯密度高、厚度标准，反而是最容易处理的一类。

安装前核对什么

到现场先量三件事：门扇实际厚度、现有锁体是 mortise 还是附加式、门框到墙边的可用宽度。窄框铝门需要单独看框宽，普通面板装不下。PJ 不少单位门外还有一层铁闸，铁闸与大门之间的间距如果小于手掌厚度，装带摄像头的型号时镜头会被挡，这时会建议改选面板较薄的款。

施工与交付

有地住宅一般可在白天连续施工；公寓单位需要先向管理处报备，部分 PJ 的旧公寓要求工作日特定时段，噪音工序还要登记。安装包含拆除旧锁、按需修整锁孔、装锁、为每位使用者录入指纹与密码或门卡，交付前从门内外两侧各测一次上锁与开锁，并说明低电量提醒、应急供电和机械钥匙的实际表现。需要开孔或改动门体的工序会在动钻之前书面确认。

按预算和使用习惯选型号

PJ 的客户大致分两类。一类是自住，希望少带钥匙、家里有长辈或小孩，这类更适合把指纹、密码、掌静脉其中之一作为主要方式，其余作为备用，面板上多一个屏幕的实际价值不大。另一类是出租或短租，重点是权限能不能干净交接、能不能给临时密码，指紋识别速度反而次要。选型时把这两类分清，比逐个型号比对参数有效。

三个常见误区

第一个是把「含安装」理解成「含所有工序」：开孔扩孔、门体补强、铁闸改位属于额外工序，需要单独确认。第二个是只看门厚不看锁体，门厚够但锁孔浅，全自动款一样装不上。第三个是等锁坏了才处理，门扇已经下垂时才想起来装锁，往往要连铰链一起修。提前一次现场核对，能把这三件事一次说清。

换锁之后门边怎么处理

SS 一带的老排屋换完锁，门边常会留下旧锁孔的痕迹。这个位置的修补方式要看木料状况：实木门可以直接用木塞补孔再上漆，夹板门补孔后容易看出色差。安装时会把新面板的覆盖范围算进去，尽量把旧孔藏在面板后面，减少修补工作量。如果旧孔超出面板覆盖范围，会在施工前说明，让客户决定是否一并处理外观。

另一个常被忽略的点是门内侧。老排屋的门内侧常有木线条收边，新面板装上去会凸出十几毫米，如果门后是窄走廊或柜体，需要确认凸出量不影响开关与通行。

门禁卡与单位门锁会不会冲突

PJ 的公寓通常有独立的大楼门禁卡，与单位门锁是两套系统，彼此不通用。电子锁配套的门卡只在单位门上有效，不能用大楼门禁卡代替，反过来也不行。住户如果习惯只带一张卡，需要把两张都带上，或者把单位门锁设为指纹或密码为主，门卡只作备用。这一点在交付时会讲清楚，避免住户以为一张卡能通到门口。

en.title: Digital Lock Installation Petaling Jaya｜Door Check First｜FLASH CAST
en.description: Digital lock supply and installation for Petaling Jaya condos and landed homes. Door thickness, lock body and frame width checked before fitting, with handover testing.
en.keywords: digital lock installation petaling jaya, smart door lock PJ, condo door lock
en.body:
Petaling Jaya splits into two door populations. The SS terraces built between the 1970s and 1990s carry solid or plywood entrance doors on older mortise bodies, and their door edges have usually been trimmed by previous lock changes. Newer PJ condos use fire-rated timber doors with standard cut-outs, which most mainstream digital locks swap into directly. Both types sit inside the same postcode, so picking a model from photos alone tends to miss.

The three doors you meet most here

The first is the old terrace timber door: nominally 40 mm, but face veneer and edge trimming eat into the usable thickness, and the lock pocket is often shallow, so a fully automatic push-pull body does not have the bolt travel it needs and the pocket has to be re-cut. The second is the steel gate added behind a terrace door, where the clear gap to the timber leaf is typically 60 to 90 mm and decides whether the keypad can sit on the handle side. The third is the post-2000 condo fire door: dense core, standard thickness, and the easiest of the three to work with.

What gets measured before anything is drilled

Actual leaf thickness, whether the existing body is mortise or surface-mounted, and the clear width from the door frame to the wall. Narrow-frame aluminium doors need the stile width measured separately because a standard panel will not sit on them. Many PJ units also have a steel gate outside; if the gap between gate and door is thinner than a hand, the lens on a camera model ends up blocked, and a slimmer panel is the better recommendation.

Working hours and handover

Landed houses can usually be worked on continuously during the day. Condo units need notice to management, and some older PJ blocks restrict noisy work to specific weekday windows. Installation covers removing the old lock, adjusting the pocket where needed, mounting the new body, enrolling fingerprints, PINs or cards for each user, and testing lock and unlock from both sides before handover, including the low-battery alert, emergency power and mechanical key. Any new drilling or door modification is confirmed in writing before it starts.

zh.title: 蕉赖电子锁安装｜公寓与排屋门体核对｜FLASH CAST
zh.description: 蕉赖公寓与排屋电子锁安装。先核对门厚、锁体与铁闸间距，再供应、安装、录入使用者并做交付测试。
zh.keywords: 蕉赖电子锁安装, Cheras 智能门锁, 公寓门锁更换
zh.body:
蕉赖是吉隆坡人口最密的住宅区之一，公寓比例高，楼龄跨度也大。九十年代的中价公寓大量使用防火木门配标准 mortise 锁，这类门反而是电子锁最好处理的场景；但同一个花园里也可能有更早期的单位，门扇已被多次修整，关不严的情况不少。关不严的门装任何电子锁都会出问题，因为斜舌对不上锁扣，锁会一直提示未上锁。

公寓比例高带来的两个具体问题

第一是铁闸。蕉赖的公寓单位普遍在入户门外加装铁闸，铁闸与门面板之间的净距常常只有一掌宽，装带屏幕或摄像头的型号时，镜头视角会被铁闸横杆切掉一块。这种情况通常建议把摄像头款改到室内屏款，或者确认铁闸能否局部拆改。第二是走廊宽度。部分老公寓的走廊很窄，人脸识别需要的站立距离不足，识别会变慢，掌静脉或指纹在这类走廊里更稳定。

门体核对的实际做法

到现场量门扇厚度、现有锁体类型、门框可用宽度，再看门扇有没有下垂。蕉赖不少单位的门用久了会下沉一到两毫米，肉眼看不出来，但斜舌会蹭到锁扣板。这种门在装锁之前要先调整铰链，否则再好的锁也会报错。窄框铝门需要单独看框宽，普通面板装不下。

施工安排与交付

公寓需要先向管理处报备，蕉赖多数公寓要求工作日白天施工，周末噪音工序需要另外申请。有地住宅与店屋则可以连续施工。安装包含拆旧锁、按需修整锁孔、装锁、录入指纹密码门卡，交付前从门内外两侧各测一次上锁与开锁，并说明低电量提醒、应急供电与机械钥匙的实际表现。需要开孔或改动门体的工序会在动钻之前书面确认。售后条款以报价单载明内容为准。

预算怎么分配更实际

蕉赖的客户问得最多的是「便宜的够不够用」。从实际场景看，公寓单位如果门外有铁闸、光线又一般，把钱花在摄像和屏幕上意义有限，因为画面本来就被挡住；把这个预算放在锁体做工、指纹识别稳定性和应急供电上更划算。反过来，门口开阔、常收包裹、经常不在家的单位，可视门铃和远程查看才是真正省事的部分。

走廊与邻里环境

蕉赖不少公寓的走廊是半开放式的，日晒雨淋会让面板加速老化，选型时外壳材质值得多问一句。另外部分老公寓走廊灯光偏暗且是感应式，人脸识别的速度会受影响，这种情况我们会如实说明，并建议以掌静脉或指纹为主。邻里间距离近的单位，语音提示音量最好在交付时调到合适档位，避免夜间开门声音扰邻。

高密度公寓的时段协调

蕉赖的公寓密度高，同一层往往有十几户，施工时段的协调比有地住宅复杂。管理处通常要求工作日白天作业，噪音工序还要另外申请，部分楼限制同一天内同时施工的单位数量。预约时会先确认可作业时段与货梯可用时间，避免师傅到了楼下等电梯。住户如果能提前一天跟邻居打个招呼，现场推进通常更顺。

另外蕉赖部分公寓的电梯需要刷卡到楼层，安装当天需要住户或授权人全程在场，或者提前把访客权限办好。这一点在预约时会一并确认。

停电时的实际表现

电子锁由电池供电，大楼停电不影响开关门。真正需要注意的是电池本身耗尽的情况：低电量提醒通常会在还能正常使用一段时间时出现，看到提醒就安排更换，比等到完全没电再处理从容。完全没电时用门外 USB 接口接充电宝可以临时供电开门，机械钥匙则是最直接的备用方式。交付时会现场演示这两条路径，住户自己动手过一次比看说明书有效。

蕉赖部分老公寓的走廊插座位很少，临时找电源不方便，所以低电量提醒出现后尽快更换更实际。

en.title: Digital Lock Installation Cheras｜Condo and Terrace Doors｜FLASH CAST
en.description: Digital lock supply and installation in Cheras. Door thickness, lock body and gate clearance checked before fitting, with handover testing from both sides.
en.keywords: digital lock installation cheras, smart door lock cheras, condo door lock
en.body:
Cheras carries one of the densest residential populations in Kuala Lumpur, with a high share of condos across a wide range of building ages. The 1990s mid-market blocks mostly use fire-rated timber doors on standard mortise bodies, which is the easiest case for a digital lock. The same neighbourhood also holds earlier units whose leaves have been trimmed by repeated lock changes, and doors that no longer close flush are common. A door that does not close flush defeats any digital lock, because the latch never lands in the strike and the lock keeps reporting an open state.

Two problems that come from the condo mix

The first is the steel gate. Cheras condo units almost always add one outside the entrance door, and the clear gap to the door face is often only a hand wide. On a model with a camera or screen, the gate's crossbars cut into the field of view. The usual answer is to move to a model with an indoor display instead of an outdoor camera, or to confirm whether the gate can be partially modified. The second is corridor width. Some older blocks have narrow corridors that leave too little standing distance for face recognition, so it reads slowly; palm vein or fingerprint is more reliable in that layout.

How the door check actually runs

Leaf thickness, existing body type and clear frame width are measured first, then the leaf is checked for sag. A lot of Cheras doors have dropped a millimetre or two over the years. It is not visible, but the latch starts grazing the strike plate, and the door has to be re-hung on its hinges before any lock will behave. Narrow-frame aluminium doors need the stile width measured separately because a standard panel will not fit.

Scheduling and handover

Condos need notice to management; most Cheras blocks allow weekday daytime work and want noisy tasks requested separately at weekends. Landed houses and shophouses can be worked on continuously. Installation covers removing the old lock, adjusting the pocket where needed, mounting the body, enrolling fingerprints, PINs and cards, and testing lock and unlock from both sides before handover, including the low-battery alert, emergency power and mechanical key. Any new drilling is confirmed in writing first, and warranty terms follow the quotation document.

zh.title: 梳邦再也电子锁安装｜有地住宅与公寓｜FLASH CAST
zh.description: 梳邦再也 USJ 一带排屋与公寓电子锁安装。先核对门厚、锁体与车房铁门间距，再供应、安装并做交付测试。
zh.keywords: 梳邦再也电子锁安装, Subang Jaya 智能门锁, USJ 门锁更换
zh.body:
梳邦再也的住宅结构以有地为主，USJ 一带的排屋占了很大比例，公寓集中在 SS15 与靠近轻轨的几段。排屋的入户门通常是实木门或实木复合门，配标准 mortise 锁，门厚足够，绝大多数型号都能装。真正需要判断的是门外那层：这一区的排屋普遍有车房铁门与一道内层木门，两层之间的距离、铁门是单开还是双开、门柱有没有留电源，都会影响最终选型。

排屋场景里最常被忽略的两件事

第一是铁门与木门之间的净距。带摄像头的型号需要镜头正对来客方向，如果铁门关上后与木门只剩很窄的缝，画面基本全黑，这时会建议改用室内屏款，把判断交给室内屏而不是门口镜头。第二是电源。全自动推拉锁与带屏型号需要充电，如果门内侧没有插座，就要把充电周期算进日常使用里，这一点在交付时会讲清楚，不能等到第一次没电才发现。

公寓单位的差别

SS15 一带的公寓楼龄偏中，防火木门配标准锁孔，安装难度不高。管理处通常要求提前登记施工，部分楼要求提交工人名单。走廊较窄的单位在人脸识别上会打折，掌静脉与指纹更稳。

交付时会做什么

安装包含拆旧锁、按需修整锁孔、装锁、为每位使用者录入指纹密码门卡，交付前从门内外两侧各测一次上锁与开锁，并演示低电量提醒、应急供电与机械钥匙的实际表现。排屋客户通常一家四到六口人，录入会按人逐一确认，避免出现某位家人指纹识别不了却没发现的情况。需要开孔或改动门体的工序会在动钻之前书面确认，售后条款以报价单载明内容为准。

一家多口的录入方式

梳邦再也的排屋多是四到六口的家庭，录入时按人逐一确认是关键步骤。孩子的指纹在成长阶段会变化，半年到一年可能需要重录一次；长辈的手指在干燥或做家务后识别率下降，交付时要让本人实际操作一遍，而不是由家人代按。这个过程多花十分钟，能省掉之后十次电话。

二次换装与旧锁处理

这一区有不少单位是从旧电子锁换成新款的。旧锁的门孔往往已经被改过，新锁不一定能沿用同一组孔位，需要现场比对孔距。拆下来的旧锁与电池属于电子废弃物，安装时会一并带走，不会留在客户家里。

车房充电位的安排

梳邦再也的排屋大多有车房，带屏幕或全自动推拉的型号需要定期充电。如果门内侧没有插座，充电就要靠移动电源临时接，操作上麻烦一些。比较实际的做法是在车房靠近门口的墙面加一个插座，装修阶段顺手做，成本很低。如果暂时不打算加，选型时可以偏向电池续航更长、充电频率更低的款。

USJ 部分排屋的门前空间较宽，摄像头款在这里的视野条件不错，但要注意车房顶灯的开关位置，夜间无人时门口无照明会让画面偏暗。

指纹录不进去怎么排查

梳邦再也的家庭成员多，录入时偶尔会遇到某位家人反复识别失败。常见原因有三个：手指太干或太湿、录入时按压力度和平时不同、以及手指有轻微脱皮。处理方式是在不同状态下各录一次，或者改用掌静脉与密码。如果多次重录仍不稳定，会如实说明该手指不适合作为主要方式，而不是硬录进去等到日常使用才发现问题。

孩子的指纹随着成长会变化，半年到一年重录一次比较稳妥。这个重录在锁上自己就能完成，不需要上门。

另外排屋门前的照明如果不足，指纹头表面容易积灰，定期擦拭能明显改善识别率。

en.title: Digital Lock Installation Subang Jaya｜Landed and Condo｜FLASH CAST
en.description: Digital lock supply and installation across Subang Jaya and USJ. Door thickness, lock body and car porch gate clearance checked before fitting.
en.keywords: digital lock installation subang jaya, smart door lock USJ, terrace house door lock
en.body:
Subang Jaya is mostly landed housing, with the USJ terraces making up the bulk and condos concentrated around SS15 and the LRT corridor. Terrace entrance doors are usually solid timber or timber-composite on a standard mortise body, thick enough that almost every model fits. What actually needs judging sits outside: most terraces here have a car porch gate plus an inner timber door, and the clear distance between the two, whether the gate is single or double leaf, and whether the pillar has power all affect the final choice.

Two things people overlook on terraces

The first is the gap between gate and door. A camera model needs the lens facing the approach; if closing the gate leaves only a narrow slot, the picture is effectively black, and an indoor-display model is the better answer because the decision moves to the screen rather than the outdoor lens. The second is power. Automatic push-pull bodies and screen models need charging, so if there is no socket on the inside, the charging cycle becomes part of daily use. That is explained at handover rather than discovered the first time the battery runs flat.

How condos differ here

The SS15 blocks are mid-aged, with fire-rated timber doors and standard cut-outs, so installation is straightforward. Management usually wants advance registration, and some buildings ask for a worker list. Narrow corridors soften face recognition performance; palm vein and fingerprint hold up better.

What handover covers

Installation covers removing the old lock, adjusting the pocket, mounting the body, and enrolling fingerprints, PINs and cards for each user, with lock and unlock tested from both sides before handover, plus a demonstration of the low-battery alert, emergency power and mechanical key. Terrace households are typically four to six people, so enrolment is confirmed person by person rather than assumed. Any new drilling is agreed in writing first, and warranty terms follow the quotation document.

zh.title: Mont Kiara 电子锁安装｜高端公寓门体核对｜FLASH CAST
zh.description: Mont Kiara 公寓电子锁安装。新楼防火门为主，先核对门厚、锁体与大楼审批时段，再供应、安装并做交付测试。
zh.keywords: Mont Kiara 电子锁安装, 公寓智能门锁, 高端公寓门锁
zh.body:
Mont Kiara 的门况相对统一：这里的公寓绝大多数是 2000 年后落成，入户门是防火木门，锁孔为标准 mortise 做法，门厚也符合主流电子锁的安装范围。这意味着选型上的不确定性比老区小，真正的难点搬到了流程上——这一区的管理处权限大、规定细，施工需要提前报备，工人要登记，部分楼还限制可施工的时段与电梯使用。

新楼反而要注意的两点

第一，门是新的，但不代表门就方正。精装交付的门有时会因为地面找平或门框安装误差，出现轻微倾斜，斜舌进锁扣时会蹭。装电子锁之前先做一次关门测试，比装完再返工省事。第二，这一区的单位常配双层门或者门内侧有装饰包边，包边会压缩面板的安装空间，尤其是带屏幕的型号，屏幕位置可能被包边挡住一部分。

住户结构与使用习惯

Mont Kiara 的住户里外籍家庭与长期不在本地的业主比例较高，出租单位也多。这类需求通常更看重两件事：一是远程管理与临时密码，方便把进门权限给清洁人员或短租客；二是换租客时能不能彻底删掉旧权限。选型时会优先确认 App 端的权限管理能力，而不只是指纹识别的速度。

施工安排与交付

施工前需要向管理处提交申请，确认可作业时段、货梯预约与工人登记。安装包含拆旧锁、按需修整锁孔、装锁、录入所有使用者，交付前从门内外两侧各测一次上锁与开锁，并说明低电量提醒、应急供电与机械钥匙的表现。带联网功能的型号会在交付时确认 Wi-Fi 覆盖，如果门口信号弱会如实说明远程功能可能受限。售后条款以报价单载明内容为准。

出租单位的交接流程

Mont Kiara 出租比例高，交接时最容易出问题的是权限没清干净。交付时会把流程走一遍：删除旧使用者的指纹、密码、门卡与 App 授权，确认锁内只剩管理员，再建立新使用者的权限。如果单位交给中介管理，建议把管理员权限留在业主手上，中介只保留临时密码。

装修期同步安装

不少单位在做装修时一并换锁，这时候要注意先后顺序：门体喷漆、贴膜或包边完成之后才装锁，否则面板容易被涂料污染，包边也可能挡住面板。如果装修队先装锁后做门，返工的概率很高。安排在收尾阶段装锁，是这一区比较常见的做法。

外籍住户的说明方式

Mont Kiara 的外籍住户比例高，交付时的操作说明会用英文讲一遍，并把关键步骤写下来留给住户。涉及 App 绑定、临时密码生成、删除旧使用者这几步，会当场演示一次再让住户自己操作一遍。语言不通导致的误操作，是这一区最常见的售后来源，讲清楚比修得快更重要。

另外这一区的单位多为精装交付，面板颜色与门体饰面搭配在选型时值得一起看，深色面板配浅色木门反差明显，有些住户会更在意这个。

短租客的临时权限

Mont Kiara 的短租单位需要频繁给出临时进门权限。带 App 管理的型号可以生成有时限的密码，到期自动失效，不必每次手动删除。如果单位交给中介打理，建议把权限生成的操作交给中介，但管理员账号留在业主手上，这样业主随时能看到谁在什么时间进过门，也能在必要时一次性清空所有临时权限。

需要提醒的是，远程功能依赖门口稳定的 Wi-Fi。这一区部分高层单位的信号在电梯厅附近会衰减，交付时会实测，信号不足会如实说明哪些功能会受限，不用远程功能不影响本地开门。

en.title: Digital Lock Installation Mont Kiara｜Condo Door Check｜FLASH CAST
en.description: Digital lock supply and installation in Mont Kiara. Newer fire-rated doors, with building approval timing and door thickness checked before fitting.
en.keywords: digital lock installation mont kiara, condo smart lock, apartment door lock
en.body:
Mont Kiara is unusually consistent. Almost every condo here went up after 2000, the entrance doors are fire-rated timber on standard mortise cut-outs, and the leaf thickness sits inside the range mainstream digital locks expect. That removes most of the model-selection uncertainty you get in older districts, and moves the real difficulty into process: management here has wide authority and detailed rules, work needs advance approval, workers are registered, and some buildings restrict working hours and lift use.

Two things a new door still gets wrong

First, a new door is not automatically a square door. Fit-out delivered doors sometimes sit slightly out of level because of floor screeding or frame installation, and the latch grazes the strike. A closing test before installing the lock saves a return visit. Second, units here often have a secondary door or a decorative casing on the inside, and that casing eats into the panel's mounting space. On screen models the display can end up partly covered.

Who lives here and how they use the lock

Mont Kiara has a high share of expatriate households and owners who are frequently abroad, plus a large rental pool. That profile cares about two things more than fingerprint speed: remote management with temporary codes, so access can be handed to a cleaner or a short-stay guest, and whether old credentials can be fully deleted at tenant changeover. Model selection therefore starts with the app's permission handling.

Scheduling and handover

Work is submitted to management in advance, with the approved window, service lift booking and worker registration confirmed first. Installation covers removing the old lock, adjusting the pocket, mounting the body and enrolling every user, with lock and unlock tested from both sides before handover, plus the low-battery alert, emergency power and mechanical key. On connected models the Wi-Fi coverage at the door is checked, and if it is weak, the limits on remote features are stated plainly rather than glossed over. Warranty terms follow the quotation document.

zh.title: Bangsar 电子锁安装｜老排屋与新公寓｜FLASH CAST
zh.description: Bangsar 老排屋与新公寓电子锁安装。先核对门厚、锁体与门框宽度，再供应、安装、录入使用者并做交付测试。
zh.keywords: Bangsar 电子锁安装, 排屋智能门锁, 公寓门锁更换
zh.body:
Bangsar 是吉隆坡门况差异最大的区之一。老排屋集中的那几条街，入户门多是几十年的实木门，门扇厚重但已经过多次修整，锁体是旧式 mortise，锁孔深度与现在的主流规格不同；同一区里新建或翻新过的公寓则是标准防火门，锁孔规范。两种门放在一起，很难用一套参数判断，必须逐户量。

老木门要特别看的三处

第一是门边。老木门的门边常被前几次换锁削薄或补过木条，装带长锁舌的全自动锁时，锁舌行程不够会导致关不严。第二是门扇与门框的缝隙。Bangsar 老排屋的门经过多年使用，缝隙可能上下不均，这会直接影响斜舌能否正常进锁扣。第三是门内侧有没有装饰线条。很多老排屋门内侧有木线条收边，面板装上去会凸出，需要确认凸出量是否影响开关。

翻新与出租单位

Bangsar 有相当比例的单位在翻新后出租或作为短租使用。这类需求的重点不是功能多，而是权限能不能干净地交接：旧租客的指纹、密码、门卡要能一次删干净，新租客的权限要能快速建立。选型时会优先看这一块的流程，而不是屏幕尺寸。

施工与交付

有地住宅白天可连续施工。公寓需要向管理处报备，Bangsar 部分公寓要求工作日施工并限制噪音时段。安装包含拆旧锁、按需修整锁孔、装锁、录入使用者，交付前从门内外两侧各测一次上锁与开锁，并说明低电量提醒、应急供电与机械钥匙的表现。老木门如果需要开孔或补强，会在动钻之前书面确认，因为老门开孔后修补成本比新门高。售后条款以报价单载明内容为准。

翻新时机的判断

Bangsar 的老排屋如果准备翻新，换锁最好放在门体工程之后。老门在打磨、上漆、修边过程中尺寸会微调，先装锁再改门，很容易出现锁舌对不上锁扣的情况。反过来，如果门体短期内不动，那就先把锁换掉，日常使用先改善，门体工程以后再说。

老门的日常维护

老木门配电子锁之后，需要留意两件事：一是铰链，门扇一旦开始下垂，锁的报错会先出现，这时候调铰链比换锁有效；二是门边的木料，老门边缘如果出现开裂或松动，锁体的固定强度会受影响，需要先补强再装。这两项都不属于锁本身的故障，但在老排屋里出现频率很高。

门内侧线条与柜体的关系

Bangsar 老排屋的门内侧经常有木线条收边，有的单位门后还贴着鞋柜或储物柜。新面板装上后会凸出十几到二十毫米，如果门后空间本来就紧，开门时会碰到柜体。这种情况下需要量门后净空，必要时改用面板较薄的型号，或者把柜体位置稍作调整。

另外老排屋的门框常有轻微变形，装锁时如果硬压面板，长期使用会出现缝隙。安装时会按实际门框的平整度调整，不追求面板完全贴合，而是保证锁舌动作顺畅。

门体改造前先咨询的意义

Bangsar 的老排屋如果计划改门，换锁的顺序值得提前想清楚。门体改小、改大、换材质、加包边，每一种都会改变可用的锁孔位置与面板空间。先咨询再改门，可以把锁的安装需求一并考虑进去，避免改完门才发现目标型号装不下。反过来，如果门体一两年内不会动，那就直接换锁，不必等。

另外老排屋的门框与墙体之间常有空隙，安装时如果发现固定点落在空鼓位置，需要用膨胀件补强。这一项属于额外工序，会在动工前说明。

en.title: Digital Lock Installation Bangsar｜Old Terrace and New Condo｜FLASH CAST
en.description: Digital lock supply and installation in Bangsar. Old timber terrace doors and newer condo fire doors checked individually before any fitting.
en.keywords: digital lock installation bangsar, terrace house smart lock, condo door lock
en.body:
Bangsar has one of the widest spreads of door conditions in Kuala Lumpur. On the streets lined with older terraces, entrance doors are decades-old solid timber: heavy leaves that have been trimmed more than once, on old mortise bodies whose pocket depth does not match current standards. Newer or renovated condos in the same area have standard fire-rated doors with standard cut-outs. One set of assumptions cannot cover both, so each unit gets measured.

Three places an old timber door needs looking at

First, the door edge. Older leaves are often planed thin or patched with timber strips by previous lock changes, and a fully automatic body with long bolt travel will not seat properly if the pocket is short. Second, the gap between leaf and frame. After years of use that gap is frequently uneven top to bottom, which decides whether the latch can enter the strike at all. Third, any decorative moulding on the inside face. Many older terrace doors have timber trim along the edge, so the panel stands proud and the protrusion has to be checked against the door's swing.

Renovated and rental units

A good share of Bangsar units are renovated for rental or short stays. That use case cares less about feature count and more about clean handover: the previous tenant's fingerprints, PINs and cards deleted in one pass, and the new tenant's access set up quickly. Model selection starts there rather than with screen size.

Working hours and handover

Landed houses can be worked on continuously during the day. Condos need notice to management, and several Bangsar buildings restrict work to weekdays with quiet-hour limits. Installation covers removing the old lock, adjusting the pocket, mounting the body and enrolling users, with lock and unlock tested from both sides before handover, plus the low-battery alert, emergency power and mechanical key. If an old timber door needs new drilling or reinforcement, that is confirmed in writing first, because repairing an older leaf costs more than drilling a new one. Warranty terms follow the quotation document.

zh.title: 蒲种电子锁安装｜新公寓与排屋｜FLASH CAST
zh.description: 蒲种新公寓与排屋电子锁安装。先核对门厚、锁体与铁闸间距，再供应、安装、录入使用者并做交付测试。
zh.keywords: 蒲种电子锁安装, Puchong 智能门锁, 公寓门锁更换
zh.body:
蒲种是巴生谷近十五年住宅增长最快的区域之一，新建公寓密度高，排屋也不少。这里的门有一个明显特征：新建项目交付时门型相对统一，同一栋楼的入户门规格基本一致，防火木门配标准 mortise 锁孔，门厚符合主流电子锁的安装范围。对安装来说是好事，但对选型来说要注意另一件事——统一的门型意味着楼上楼下装的锁也差不多，管理处对面板颜色和外观有时会有统一要求。

新公寓的两个实务问题

第一是铁闸。蒲种新公寓的入户门外普遍加装铁闸，很多是交付后统一加装，铁闸与门面之间的净距较窄，带摄像头的型号镜头容易被横杆挡住。第二是走廊长度。新公寓走廊一般够宽，人脸识别的站立距离不成问题，但如果单位靠近电梯厅，人来人往会让摄像头频繁触发，这时候把逗留抓拍的灵敏度调到合适档位比换型号更实际。

排屋与家庭使用

蒲种的排屋多为年轻家庭，家庭成员三到五人，日常进出频繁。这类需求更看重的是稳定而不是功能堆叠：指纹在小孩手指发育期识别率会波动，掌静脉或密码作为补充更实用。家里有长辈的，钥匙扣这类不需要记密码也不需要按指纹的方式往往更受欢迎。

施工与交付

公寓需要向管理处报备并登记工人，蒲种多数新公寓要求工作日白天施工。安装包含拆旧锁、按需修整锁孔、装锁、为每位家庭成员逐一录入，交付前从门内外两侧各测一次上锁与开锁，并说明低电量提醒、应急供电与机械钥匙的表现。带联网功能的型号会在交付时测门口 Wi-Fi 信号。需要开孔或改动门体的工序会在动钻之前书面确认，售后条款以报价单载明内容为准。

小孩与长辈的使用差异

蒲种的年轻家庭多，孩子的指纹在发育期稳定性不足，实际使用中容易被判为识别失败。比较稳妥的做法是把密码作为孩子的主要方式，指纹作为辅助，等手指发育稳定后再调整。长辈则相反，指纹磨损较明显，掌静脉或钥匙扣更省事。

摄像头灵敏度的设置

带摄像头的型号在走廊人流大的单位会频繁触发，耗电也会增加。交付时会把逗留抓拍的灵敏度调到适合该户位置的档位，靠近电梯厅的单位通常调低，走廊尽头的单位可以保持默认。这个设置不是一次定终身，住户使用一段时间后可以再调整。

统一外观要求的处理

蒲种部分新公寓对入户门外观有统一要求，管理处会规定面板颜色或者不允许改动门体外观。预约前先确认这一点，能避免装完被要求拆回。如果确实有颜色限制，选型时优先看哑光黑或深灰这类常见配色，主流型号里这两个色系的选择最多。

另外新公寓的门多为精装交付，门面饰板比较脆，安装时需要做好保护，避免工具磕碰留下凹痕。这一点在施工时会用保护垫处理。

电池更换与提醒

蒲种的住户问得最多的是电池多久换一次。实际周期取决于开门次数、是否带屏幕、摄像头触发频率这几个因素，同一型号在不同家庭差别很大，所以不给固定月数。能确定的是低电量提醒会在完全耗尽之前出现，看到提醒就该准备更换，不要等到锁提示电量不足才临时找电池。

带屏幕与摄像头的型号多为充电电池，充电时锁仍可正常使用，不需要拆下来寄修。交付时会说明充电口位置与大概的充电时长，以及充电期间哪些功能会暂时停用。

en.title: Digital Lock Installation Puchong｜New Condo and Terrace｜FLASH CAST
en.description: Digital lock supply and installation in Puchong. Newer condo fire doors and terrace houses, with door thickness and gate clearance checked before fitting.
en.keywords: digital lock installation puchong, smart door lock puchong, condo door lock
en.body:
Puchong is one of the fastest-growing residential areas in the Klang Valley over the last fifteen years, with dense new condo supply and a steady share of terraces. Doors here have a clear pattern: newly handed-over projects are uniform, so entrance doors within one block share the same specification, fire-rated timber on standard mortise cut-outs, with leaf thickness inside the range mainstream digital locks expect. That helps installation, but raises a different point for selection. Uniform doors mean the neighbours are fitting similar locks, and management sometimes has a view on panel colour and appearance.

Two practical issues in newer condos

The first is the steel gate. Puchong units almost always add one outside the entrance door, often installed centrally after handover, and the gap to the door face is narrow enough that a camera lens ends up behind the crossbars. The second is corridor length. Corridors here are usually wide enough for face recognition, but a unit near the lift lobby sees constant foot traffic, which trips the camera repeatedly. Tuning the lingering-capture sensitivity usually helps more than changing the model.

Terraces and family use

Puchong terraces tend to hold younger families of three to five, with frequent daily coming and going. That profile values reliability over feature count. Fingerprint reads fluctuate while children's fingers are still developing, so palm vein or a PIN makes a more practical backup. For elderly family members, a key fob that needs neither a PIN nor a fingerprint is often the preferred option.

Scheduling and handover

Condos need notice to management and worker registration; most newer Puchong blocks allow weekday daytime work. Installation covers removing the old lock, adjusting the pocket, mounting the body and enrolling each family member individually, with lock and unlock tested from both sides before handover, plus the low-battery alert, emergency power and mechanical key. On connected models the Wi-Fi signal at the door is tested. Any new drilling is confirmed in writing first, and warranty terms follow the quotation document.

zh.title: 雪兰莪电子锁安装｜全州上门核对门体｜FLASH CAST
zh.description: 雪兰莪全州电子锁销售与安装。从八打灵、梳邦、蒲种到莎阿南、巴生、加影，安装前先核对门厚、锁体与门框宽度。
zh.keywords: 雪兰莪电子锁安装, Selangor 智能门锁, 全州上门安装
zh.body:
雪兰莪是马来西亚住宅形态最复杂的州属之一。同一个州里既有八打灵、梳邦这类成熟城区，也有莎阿南、巴生这类以有地住宅为主的区域，还有蒲种、赛城、加影这些近年快速扩张的新住宅带。住宅形态不同，门况也不同，所以雪兰莪不适合用一套统一说法去推荐型号，只能先按门的实际情况分类。

按住宅形态分出的三类门

第一类是成熟城区的排屋：门龄长，实木门经过多次修整，锁体多为旧式 mortise，锁孔深度与主流规格不同，往往需要按实际情况修孔。第二类是近十五年新建的公寓与排屋：防火木门配标准锁孔，门厚标准，主流电子锁基本能直接替换，安装时间也最短。第三类是有地住宅的加装门：铁花门、铁闸、玻璃门、推拉门，这类门的固定方式与走线各自不同，不能用木门那套做法套上去。

全州上门要解决的实际问题

雪兰莪范围大，从巴生到加影横跨数十公里，上门时间需要按区域排。安装前会先要求提供三张照片：整扇门连两侧框、门边锁舌位置、以及门外铁闸与大门之间的距离。这三张照片能排除掉大部分不适配的情况，避免师傅白跑一趟。真正需要现场判断的，是门扇是否方正、锁孔能不能沿用、以及带屏幕型号的安装位置会不会被门框包边挡住。

施工范围与交付

安装包含拆除原有机械锁或电子锁、按需修整锁孔、装上新锁、为每位使用者录入指纹密码门卡或 App 权限，交付前从门内外两侧各测一次上锁与开锁，并说明低电量提醒、应急供电与机械钥匙的实际表现。公寓单位需要提前向管理处报备，有地住宅则可连续施工。需要开孔或改动门体的工序会在动钻之前书面确认，售后条款以报价单载明内容为准。

跨区预约怎么排更省时间

雪兰莪范围大，从巴生到加影一趟可能横跨一小时车程。预约时会按区域集中安排，同一带的单位尽量排在同一天，减少等待。客户方面能做的是把三张照片提前发过来，并确认当天有人在场、管理处已报备。这三件事做到，绝大多数安装可以一次完成，不需要二次上门。

偏远小区的两个准备

雪兰莪部分围篱社区位于较偏的位置，进出需要登记，有的还限制外来车辆时段。预约前先确认访客登记流程与车辆进入规定，能避免师傅到了门口进不去。另外新建小区有时手机信号与 Wi-Fi 覆盖都不理想，带联网功能的型号在交付时会实测，信号不足会如实说明哪些远程功能会受限。

保养与售后响应

雪兰莪范围大，售后响应按区域排期。常见的售后问题大多不是锁坏了，而是电池耗尽、指纹识别率下降、面板需要清洁这几类。交付时会把这几项的处理方式讲清楚，能自己解决的不需要等上门。确实需要上门的，会按所在区域安排最近的时段。

如果住户在保固期内搬家或者单位转租，建议先联系确认权限交接与保修是否随单位转移，这部分以报价单载明的条款为准，不做口头承诺。

旧锁拆下来怎么处理

雪兰莪的安装都会把拆下来的旧锁与旧电池一并带走，不留在客户家里。机械锁属于金属废料，电子锁含电池与电路板，混在生活垃圾里并不合适。这一项不需要额外收费，属于安装流程的一部分。

如果客户希望保留旧锁作为备用，也可以在施工前说明，师傅会完整拆下并交回。部分老排屋的原装锁具有纪念价值，这种情况我们会完整保留，不做破坏性拆解。

en.title: Digital Lock Installation Selangor｜Statewide Door Check｜FLASH CAST
en.description: Digital lock supply and installation across Selangor, from Petaling and Subang to Shah Alam, Klang and Kajang. Door thickness and lock body checked before fitting.
en.keywords: digital lock installation selangor, smart door lock selangor, statewide installation
en.body:
Selangor holds the widest range of housing types in Malaysia. One state covers mature districts like Petaling and Subang, landed-heavy areas like Shah Alam and Klang, and the fast-expanding new belts around Puchong, Cyberjaya and Kajang. Different housing means different doors, so a single blanket recommendation does not work here. The door is sorted first, then the model follows.

Three door categories by housing type

The first is the mature-district terrace: an older solid timber leaf trimmed repeatedly over the years, on an old mortise body whose pocket depth does not match current standards, usually needing the pocket adjusted to suit. The second is the condo or terrace built in the last fifteen years: fire-rated timber on a standard cut-out, standard thickness, a direct swap for most mainstream models and the quickest install of the three. The third is the added door on landed property: steel gates, grilles, glass doors and sliding doors, each with its own fixing method and cable route, none of which accepts timber-door practice.

What statewide coverage actually requires

Selangor spans dozens of kilometres from Klang to Kajang, so visits are routed by area. Three photos are requested first: the whole door with both frame legs, the lock area on the door edge, and the distance between the outer gate and the door. Those three rule out most incompatible cases before anyone drives out. What genuinely needs an on-site decision is whether the leaf is square, whether the existing cut-out can be reused, and whether frame casing will obstruct a screen model's mounting position.

Scope and handover

Installation covers removing the existing mechanical or electronic lock, adjusting the pocket where needed, mounting the new body, enrolling fingerprints, PINs, cards or app access for each user, and testing lock and unlock from both sides before handover, including the low-battery alert, emergency power and mechanical key. Condo units need notice to management; landed houses can be worked on continuously. Any new drilling is confirmed in writing first, and warranty terms follow the quotation document.

zh.title: 莎阿南电子锁安装｜有地住宅门体核对｜FLASH CAST
zh.description: 莎阿南有地住宅与公寓电子锁安装。先核对门厚、锁体与车房铁门间距，再供应、安装、录入使用者并做交付测试。
zh.keywords: 莎阿南电子锁安装, Shah Alam 智能门锁, 排屋门锁更换
zh.body:
莎阿南的住宅以有地为主，排屋与半独立占多数，公寓集中在几个特定区块。这里的入户门有几个稳定特征：门扇偏厚、多为实木或实木复合、配标准 mortise 锁，门框做得比较规整。对电子锁来说这是相对好处理的场景，多数主流型号都能装，安装时间也短。真正需要判断的是门外那一层车房铁门。

车房铁门带来的选型限制

莎阿南的排屋普遍有车房，入户门前还有一道铁门。铁门与木门之间的距离、铁门的开启方向、门柱有没有预留电源，这三点直接决定能不能装带摄像头的型号。如果净距窄，镜头会被铁门挡住，这种情况下室内屏款比门口摄像款更实用——判断交给室内屏幕，而不是指望门口那个视角。另外，部分较新的排屋在车房设了卷门，白天长期关闭，门口光线弱，人脸在这个环境下识别会变慢，掌静脉与指纹更稳。

家庭结构与使用习惯

莎阿南的家庭规模通常大于市中心公寓，四到六口人常见，三代同住的情况不少。这意味着录入时要按人逐一确认，尤其是长辈的指纹在干燥或劳作后识别率会下降，交付时要演示备用方式怎么用。家里有帮佣或长期访客的，临时密码比多录一个指纹更合适。

施工与交付

有地住宅白天可连续施工，不需要像公寓那样层层报备。安装包含拆旧锁、按需修整锁孔、装锁、录入使用者，交付前从门内外两侧各测一次上锁与开锁，并说明低电量提醒、应急供电与机械钥匙的表现。需要开孔或改动门体的工序会在动钻之前书面确认，售后条款以报价单载明内容为准。

三代同住的权限安排

莎阿南的家庭规模偏大，三代同住常见。建议把权限分层：业主保留管理员权限，可以增删使用者；同住家人各自一组指纹与密码；帮佣或长期访客用临时密码，到期自动失效。这样换人时只需要处理一层，不必动到全家人的设置。

车房卷门与门口光线

部分较新的排屋在车房装了卷门，白天长期关闭，门口几乎无自然光。这个环境下人脸识别会明显变慢，交付时会如实说明，并建议以掌静脉或指纹为主。如果住户希望用人脸，可以在门口加装感应灯，成本不高但效果直接。

大户型多门配置

莎阿南的半独立与大户型常有多个出入口：大门、侧门、后门、佣人房。全部换成电子锁并不一定划算，比较常见的做法是主入口用功能完整的型号，侧门与后门用基础款，权限统一管理。这样预算集中在主要使用动线上，次要出入口也能免去带钥匙的麻烦。

需要注意的是不同型号的管理方式可能不通用，多个品牌混用会让权限管理变复杂。选同一系列的产品，交接和日常维护会简单很多。

多个门同时装的顺序

莎阿南的大户型如果同时装几道门，顺序上建议先做主入口，再处理侧门与后门。主入口涉及的判断最多，门体状况、铁门间距、电源位置都要确认，先把这一道做完，其余门的方案往往可以参照。全部做完之后统一做一次权限核对，确保每道门的授权名单一致，不会出现某道门漏录某位家人的情况。

如果几道门用的是不同型号，管理方式可能不一致，交付时会把每道门的操作方式分别写下来，避免住户记混。

如果住户打算分阶段安装，先把主入口做完再观察一段时间，通常比一次性全换更从容，后续选型也能参照实际使用感受调整。

en.title: Digital Lock Installation Shah Alam｜Landed Home Door Check｜FLASH CAST
en.description: Digital lock supply and installation in Shah Alam. Landed houses and condos, with door thickness, lock body and car porch gate clearance checked before fitting.
en.keywords: digital lock installation shah alam, smart door lock shah alam, terrace house door lock
en.body:
Shah Alam is predominantly landed, with terraces and semi-detached houses making up most of the stock and condos grouped in a few pockets. Entrance doors here are consistent: thicker leaves, solid or composite timber, standard mortise bodies, and frames built to a tidy tolerance. That makes it a comparatively easy case for digital locks, most mainstream models fit, and installation is quick. The real constraint sits one layer out, at the car porch gate.

How the porch gate narrows the choice

Shah Alam terraces almost all have a porch, so there is a steel gate before the entrance door. The distance between gate and door, the direction the gate opens, and whether the pillar has power decide whether a camera model is viable at all. If the gap is narrow, the lens sits behind the gate and an indoor-display model is the better answer, because the decision moves to the screen instead of an obstructed outdoor view. Some newer terraces also have a roller shutter over the porch that stays closed through the day, leaving the doorway dim; face recognition slows in that light while palm vein and fingerprint hold up.

Household size and habits

Shah Alam households are generally larger than city-centre condos, with four to six people common and three generations under one roof not unusual. Enrolment therefore gets confirmed person by person, especially for older family members whose fingerprints read less reliably when hands are dry or after manual work. The backup method is demonstrated at handover. Where there is a helper or a long-staying visitor, a temporary code works better than enrolling an extra fingerprint.

Scheduling and handover

Landed houses can be worked on continuously during the day without the layered approvals a condo requires. Installation covers removing the old lock, adjusting the pocket, mounting the body and enrolling users, with lock and unlock tested from both sides before handover, plus the low-battery alert, emergency power and mechanical key. Any new drilling is confirmed in writing first, and warranty terms follow the quotation document.

zh.title: 加影电子锁安装｜排屋与新公寓｜FLASH CAST
zh.description: 加影排屋与新公寓电子锁安装。先核对门厚、锁体与门框宽度，再供应、安装、录入使用者并做交付测试。
zh.keywords: 加影电子锁安装, Kajang 智能门锁, 排屋门锁更换
zh.body:
加影的住宅结构在过去十年变化很大：传统排屋仍是主体，但新建公寓与围篱社区增长明显。门况因此分成两段——早期排屋的入户门是实木门，门龄长，锁体多为旧式做法；新建项目的防火木门配标准锁孔，规格统一。同一条街上就可能同时存在这两种情况，所以不能按区域一刀切给建议。

早期排屋需要先处理的老化问题

加影不少排屋的门已经用了二三十年，问题不在锁，而在门上。门扇下沉、铰链松动、关门时需要抬一下才能对上锁扣，这些都会让电子锁误报未上锁。这类门在装锁之前要先调整铰链，必要时补强门框，否则换再好的锁也会反复出现提示。另外老门的门边常被前几次换锁修薄，装长锁舌的全自动款时行程不够，需要重新修孔。

围篱社区与新公寓

加影的围篱社区通常有两道门：社区闸门与自家入户门。社区闸门不归住户管，入户门才是要处理的。新公寓的管理处一般要求提前报备施工并登记工人，部分楼限制工作日时段。走廊宽度这一项在新公寓基本不成问题，人脸识别的站立距离够用。

施工与交付

安装包含拆旧锁、按需修整锁孔、装锁、为每位使用者录入指纹密码门卡，交付前从门内外两侧各测一次上锁与开锁，并说明低电量提醒、应急供电与机械钥匙的表现。老排屋如果涉及门框补强或重新开孔，会在动钻之前书面确认，因为木质老化后的修补方式与新材料不同。售后条款以报价单载明内容为准。

搬到新居时的安装时机

加影有不少客户是刚拿钥匙的新居，装修与换锁往往同时进行。和装修队的顺序要提前讲清楚：门体安装、喷漆、包边完成之后再装锁。如果门是开发商原装且短期不改，那可以先装锁，日常使用先解决。

老排屋的门框补强

加影早期排屋用的木料有些已经老化，锁体固定位置如果正好落在疏松木料上，螺丝会吃不住力。这种情况需要先补强门框再装锁，否则用一段时间面板会松。补强属于额外工序，会在动工前单独说明，不会混在安装费里含混过去。

围篱社区的访客登记

加影的围篱社区进出需要登记，部分社区还限制外来施工人员的时间段与车辆。预约前先确认访客流程，把车牌与人员信息提前报给保安，能省掉门口等待。有些社区要求业主本人到门口接人，这一点最好在预约时说明。

另外社区内道路较窄，工具与门体的搬运距离可能较长，安装当天需要预留搬运时间。这些细节不影响安装质量，但会影响当天的实际用时。

装修完成后多久装锁

加影的新居客户常问装锁应该排在装修的哪一步。比较稳妥的顺序是：门体安装完成、喷漆与包边做完、现场清理干净之后，再装电子锁。原因是涂料与粉尘会污染面板，包边可能改变面板位置，而清理过程中的磕碰对已经装好的锁最不友好。把锁放在收尾阶段，返工概率最低。

如果工期紧、必须先装锁，至少要用保护膜把面板包起来，并在喷漆时遮挡，装完之后再撕掉。这些保护措施不额外收费，但需要提前说。

另外，刚完成装修的单位墙面与门框可能还在轻微变形期，装锁后一个月内如果发现关门手感变紧，多数是门体适应湿度后的正常变化，调一次锁扣位置即可，不需要换锁。

en.title: Digital Lock Installation Kajang｜Terrace and New Condo｜FLASH CAST
en.description: Digital lock supply and installation in Kajang. Older terraces and newer condos, with door condition, lock body and frame width checked before fitting.
en.keywords: digital lock installation kajang, smart door lock kajang, terrace house door lock
en.body:
Kajang's housing stock has shifted a lot in ten years. Traditional terraces still dominate, but new condos and gated communities have grown quickly, so doors fall into two eras. Older terrace entrance doors are solid timber with long service life and old-style lock bodies; new projects use fire-rated timber on standard cut-outs with uniform specifications. Both can sit on the same street, which is why area-wide assumptions do not hold.

Ageing problems to fix before the lock goes on

Plenty of Kajang terraces have doors that are twenty to thirty years old, and the problem is the door rather than the lock. Dropped leaves, loose hinges and the need to lift the door slightly before it meets the strike all cause a digital lock to report an open state. Those doors need the hinges adjusted, and sometimes the frame reinforced, before any lock will behave; otherwise a better lock just produces the same warning. Older leaves have also been planed thin by repeated lock changes, so a fully automatic body with long bolt travel will not seat without re-cutting the pocket.

Gated communities and new condos

Kajang's gated communities have two layers: the community guard gate and the unit's own entrance door. The guard gate is not the resident's to change; the entrance door is. New condos generally require advance notice to management and worker registration, and some restrict work to weekdays. Corridor width is rarely an issue in these buildings, so face recognition has the standing distance it needs.

Scheduling and handover

Installation covers removing the old lock, adjusting the pocket, mounting the body and enrolling fingerprints, PINs and cards, with lock and unlock tested from both sides before handover, plus the low-battery alert, emergency power and mechanical key. Where an older terrace needs frame reinforcement or fresh drilling, that is confirmed in writing first, because repair methods on aged timber differ from new material. Warranty terms follow the quotation document.
